parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json.body;const required=['deals'];const missing=required.filter(f=>!body[f]);if(missing.length)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'Missing: '+missing.join(', ')}}];const deals=Array.isArray(body.deals)?body.deals:[];if(deals.length===0)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'deals must be non-empty'}}];const formatted=deals.slice(0,60).map((d,i)=>({id:d.id||('DEAL-'+String(i+1).padStart(3,'0')),companyName:(d.company_name||'').trim(),outcome:d.outcome||'lost',dealValue:parseFloat(d.deal_value)||null,currency:d.currency||body.currency||'USD',competitor:d.competitor||'',salesStage:d.sales_stage||'',dealAgeDays:parseInt(d.deal_age_days)||null,primaryReason:(d.primary_reason||'').trim().slice(0,300),notes:(d.notes||'').trim().slice(0,500),segment:d.segment||'',repName:d.rep_name||''}));const wonCount=formatted.filter(d=>d.outcome==='won').length;const lostCount=formatted.filter(d=>d.outcome==='lost').length;return[{json:{valid:true,periodLabel:(body.period_label||'').trim(),productName:(body.product_name||'').trim(),deals:formatted,dealCount:formatted.length,wonCount,lostCount,currency:body.currency||'USD',competitiveContext:(body.competitive_context||'').slice(0,400),replyEmail:body.reply_email||null}}];

values.content: You analyze win/loss data for B2B sales teams. Good win/loss analysis: groups similar reasons into actionable themes rather than listing every unique note, distinguishes controllable factors (pricing, product gaps) from uncontrollable ones (budget freeze, internal reorg), identifies patterns by segment or competitor, and gives specific recommendations tied to the data. Always respond in valid JSON only.
